texts.facts: The plaintiff requested defendant no.2 for a proper prescription but she refused the same. Since Jasvinder Singh vs Bharat Singh and Ors. Brij Sweets and Caterers vs Jasvinder Singh 24.03.2019, the plaintiff has been running from pillar to post to take legal action against both the defendants and therefore, joint and vicarious liability was attracted against all the defendants. Due to the negligence of defendants, the plaintiff is claiming Rs.5,00,000/- for general damages for pain and suffering suffered by the plaintiff, and Rs.5,00,000/- as special damages for the incident that has been caused due to negligence of defendants to be paid jointly and vicariously by the defendants. Hence, the present suit. On 02.11.2019, Written Statement was filed by defendant no.1 alongwith counter claim and letter dated 31.05.2019 of Mediation Centre addressed to Department of Law and Justice.
texts.arguments: Brij Sweets and Caterers vs Jasvinder Singh i.e. 24.03.2019 when the plaintiff had purchased dhokla from the shop of the defendant no.1, then it is obvious that dhokla was prepared in plenty numbers for sale in the market and it was sold to the prospective purchasers but none has reported it to be of inferior quality or that the same was injurious to health nor any such report is heard by defendant no.1 that after eating dhokla, any prospective purchaser suffered illness and food poisoning. He submitted that defendants no.3,4 and 5, who were responsible for regulating and controlling the services being provided by defendant no.1 and 2, would also be liable vicariously for the poor and negligent services / goods provided by them. (II) The plaintiff has not been able to prove that the defendant no.1 was in the habit of selling poor and adulterated and unhygienic food or that any complaint had ever been made against them qua the poor quality of food to the relevant government Brij Sweets And Caterers..Through ... vs Jasvinder Singh on 26 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32787589/ 7 authorities.
